description: Explain an Adobe Commerce module configuration file (di.xml, events.xml, webapi.xml, db_schema.xml, crontab.xml, routes.xml, system.xml, acl.xml, config.xml, layout, ui_component, schema.graphqls, requirejs-config.js and more): what it is for, where it goes (folder and area), the XSD URN from the docs, and the documentation pages. Use it before creating or editing one of these files.

file.description: Config file name or path inside a module (e.g. "di.xml", "etc/adminhtml/system.xml", "db_schema.xml", "crontab.xml", "webapi.xml", "view/frontend/layout/catalog_product_view.xml", "requirejs-config.js")

name: explain-config-file
title: Explain a module config file
